exposure: Type of surgery: total hip replacement (THR), total knee replacement (TKR), and caesarean section (CS)
Use of pre-designed procedure-specific consent forms (PCFs)
outcome: Completeness of risk reporting in PCFs
finding: Very few NHS Trusts utilize pre-designed procedure-specific consent forms for common operations, and those that are used often lack completeness in reporting risks and their likelihood.
mod_finding: 24.2% of CS PCFs contained all 17 RCOG-quoted risks.
